chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washa, from the one whom he mentioned, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Indeed, Allah, Exalted is His Remembrance, gave permission for the destruction of the Banu Umayya after they burned Zayd over seven days.
ai.seo_question: What was the divine reason for the destruction of the Banu Umayya according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the divine decree for the Umayyad dynasty's downfall directly to their specific act of martyrdom against Zayd ibn Ali, highlighting the theological weight of their persecution of the Ahl al-Bayt. This narration, found in al-Kafi, underscores the concept of 'divine retribution' (taqdir) where historical events are viewed as the fulfillment of God's promise to punish oppressors of the Prophet's family.

en.hubeali: H 14613 – A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al-Hassan Bin Ali Al-Washa, from the one whom he mentioned, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws
having said that: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Gave Permission for the destruction of the Clan of Umayya seven days after their burning of the body of Zayd’.
en.sarwar: 165. A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al-Hassan Bin Ali Al-Washa, from the one whom he mentioned, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) having said that:
‘Allah (azwj) Gave Permission for the destruction of the Clan of Umayya seven days after their burning of the body of Zayd’.
